items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: Hydel opened one down here on the highway, which was known as the Roundivou.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's what I'm saying. You said you had one of the only clubs.

Well, but his club didn't compare with ours. Foster had one called the Rainbow Room. Rainbow Room. He didn't compare with us at all. Hydel opened one down here on the highway, which was known as the Roundivou. It was fabulous, but it was too far out. Yeah. Yeah, too far out. The Transitution was like it is now, you see. But his was fabulous. We had the fabulous one. We had the first one brought out these glass bricks with the light behind them. We also had a glass brick bar with the light behind it, you know. And…
